name: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto
positioning: Japanese-inspired, minimalist hotel in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, built around a garden connected to the Nobu Palo Alto restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable Downtown Palo Alto base near Stanford University
Guests drawn to Japanese design, Ryokan-style rooms and Nobu dining

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, in Silicon Valley.
Downtown Palo Alto has walkable, tree-lined streets with open-air cafes, farmers' markets, theatres and bookstores.
The interior, created by Montalba Architects, is defined by neutral hues, natural materials and minimalist style.
Spaces are designed to integrate indoor and outdoor areas so guests can enjoy the city's weather.
Rooms feature the signature Nobu bed and linen yukata.
Rooms come with Natura Bisse bath amenities and complimentary Nespresso and Ikaati tea.
Service is infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.
The Nobu Palo Alto restaurant serves Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature dishes, such as Black Cod Miso, alongside California-inspired plates and exclusive sakes unique to Palo Alto.
On weekends, afternoon tea is served with Ikaati Tea in the Japanese-inspired garden.
A 24/7 fitness center on the second floor has Technogym equipment.
Children under 12 stay free with an accompanying adult, and cribs are available on request at no additional charge.
Stanford University's campus, Filoli Historic House and Gardens and Baylands Nature Preserve are nearby.

highlights.text: The hotel's design centerpiece is its garden, connected to the Nobu Palo Alto restaurant, which merges craftsmanship with traditional Japanese elements.
Accommodations include Ryokan rooms and suites alongside guest rooms and suites.
The exterior has a wood facade inspired by Northern California, complemented by a custom mural of El Palo Alto.
The hotel embodies the Japanese philosophy of Shiawase, a celebration of happiness and well-being.
The spa partner, Watercourse Way Bath House Spa, offers private hot tub rooms with steam or sauna facilities and massages.

considerations.text: Spa treatments are at the partner Watercourse Way Bath House Spa, about a five-minute walk from the hotel, not on site.
Pets are not allowed, and parking is by paid valet at a daily rate.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
